description: Rehlaty shared three.js engine bundle. Builds assets/games/three_shared.js, which sets window.__THREE__ once so every 3D game loads one shared copy of three@0.170.0 instead of bundling its own. Games are built with cozy_kit/build_game.mjs, which resolves 'three' to cozy_kit/three_shim.js.
name: three_shared
